newsitem.title: USA: ABC Rail sees Q1 '97 similar to yr-ago Q1.
newsitem.headline: ABC Rail sees Q1 '97 similar to yr-ago Q1.

text.p: ABC Rail Products Corp said Thursday it expects its results for the first quarter ending in October will be similar to last year's period.
Looking ahead, however, the railroad equipment maker said it expects improved results in fiscal 1997 compared with fiscal 1996.
In first quarter 1995 ABC Rail earned $0.27 a share.
ABC Rail said many of its plants typically shut down in the first quarter for annual maintenance and refurbishment.
Beyond the first quarter, it added, fiscal 1997 may be somewhat less cyclical than normal.
"The upcoming 1997 fiscal year looks to be stronger than 1996," Don Grinter, chairman, said in a statement.
Earlier, ABC Rail reported net income for the fourth quarter ended July 31 of $0.52 a share, up from $0.47 a year ago. For fiscal 1996, it earned $0.81 a share, compared with $1.46 before charges.
"ABC Rail finished the year with a good fourth quarter, closing out a 'very tough' year," Grinter said.
He said fiscal 1996 was a challenge due to delays in the market place caused by railroad mergers and a fire at the company's wheel plant.

"In spite of these short-term problems, we continued our focus on long-term opportunities defined by our strategic plan," Grinter said. "We are optimistic we will see increased demand in our core businesses during fiscal 1997. We anticipate continued growth of revenues and earnings through additional acquisitions, alliances, joint ventures and internal development."

In the fourth quarter, sales declined to $63.4 million from $70.2 million. It attributed the 9.7 percent drop to $900,000 of composition brake shoe sales now in a joint venture, $2.4 million additional intercompany wheel sales to wheel mounting shops, and a decline in track work shipments of $3.8 million due to mergers.
